name: Candy's Animatronic Workshop
franchise: Five Nights at Candy's — fan-origin series by Emil Macko
backstory: Three intact stage machines earn the venue's next facility improvement. Flexible fire, precise support and heavy contact give the business practical arena coverage.
strategy_personality: A coherent restaurant-animatronic collection with recognizable animal heads, stage costumes, and mechanical bodies. Use the same game's intact models for all three; damaged and later variants remain alternatives. Venue investment supplies a useful Tycoon identity within existing mechanics. Credit Emil Macko and identify the series' Fanverse association without treating these characters as part of the main Five Nights at Freddy's story continuity.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Five Nights at Candy's — fan-origin series by Emil Macko  
**Strategy:** Tycoon · **Target roster:** 3 robots

**Proposed robots:** Candy; Cindy; Chester.

**Direction:** A coherent restaurant-animatronic collection with recognizable animal heads, stage costumes, and mechanical bodies. Use the same game's intact models for all three; damaged and later variants remain alternatives. Venue investment supplies a useful Tycoon identity within existing mechanics. Credit Emil Macko and identify the series' Fanverse association without treating these characters as part of the main Five Nights at Freddy's story continuity.

References: [creator's Remastered release page](https://gamejolt.com/games/five-nights-at-candy-s-remastered/426659), [reproduced creator update describing the series and Fanverse](https://www.reddit.com/r/fivenightsatfreddys/comments/17dg6nx/the_fnac_series_update_post_by_emil_macko/).

**Production edition:** Five Nights at Candy's Remastered (2019), intact Emil Macko models.  
**Catalogue key:** `candys-animatronic-workshop`
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–2; follow income-facility goals before recruiting slot 3 with a funded complete stage-0 loadout. Upgrade final equipment in slot order after the roster and income base are secure. No weapon refinement purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
